main_measure.name: Mean next-bar return after active bars minus mean next-bar return over all bars
main_measure.threshold: Confirm: excess < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 60 active bars and negative in >= 4 of 6 windows; reject: excess >= 0 with >= 60 active bars; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of next-bar return on signed forecast across active bars (should be > 0)

decided_by: Reject: the excess return is zero or positive with at least 60 active bars.
reading: Active bars are those with forecast != 0; the baseline is every bar of the same windows (horizon 1, so all bars are on the grid); the t is Welch's between the active and all-bar returns; a window with no active bars does not count as negative; the supporting slope regresses next-bar return on the signed forecast, so a positive slope means a larger short is followed by a larger fall.
